name: Iniobong
tagline: Mapping Africa's story — one dataset at a time.
subtitle: Geospatial developer building earth-observation tools & spatial data products · Podcast Host · GEM Erasmus+ Alumni
intro: I'm Iniobong Benson — a geospatial analyst and earth observation specialist with an MSc from the University of Tartu & ITC, University of Twente. I build geospatial tools and earth-observation products at the intersection of remote sensing, hydrological modelling, and spatial data science, with a focus on Africa. I also founded and host Geospatially Africa, a podcast dedicated to geospatial innovation across the continent.
university: University of Tartu & ITC, University of Twente
description: Geospatial analyst and earth observation specialist with an Erasmus+ MSc, specialising in remote sensing, hydrological modelling, and spatial data science applied to Africa. Founder and host of the Geospatially Africa podcast.
